verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical, so they share the same flaws. The flavour pills are blown up to roughly the size of the CTA and compete with 'Shop Flavours' for attention. The CTA floats right-aligned and doesn't line up with the left text column. The pill rows are ragged: Honey Rosemary is indented and doesn't line up with Blood Orange or the CTA. The bottom block is cramped, while the peach circle in the bottom-right corner is a cropped leftover.
